[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepositoryUrl = "https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code.git",
    [switch]$InstallBuildTools,
    [switch]$SkipBaseline,
    [switch]$SkipSystemPackages
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$Root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot

& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "validate_powershell.ps1")
python (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "verify_materials.py")
python (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "verify_workspace_manifest.py")

$preArgs = @{
    InstallBuildTools = $InstallBuildTools
    SkipSystemPackages = $SkipSystemPackages
}
& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "acquire_windows_prerequisites.ps1") @preArgs

$env:PATH = "$Root\.tools\bin;$env:PATH"

$bundle = Join-Path $Root "input\upstream_reference\git-bundles\t3code-c1ec1915fc16f3dc1ec5d47d9a97f6210a574526.bundle"
if (Test-Path $bundle) {
    & (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "acquire_source.ps1") -RepositoryUrl $RepositoryUrl -BundlePath $bundle
} else {
    & (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "acquire_source.ps1") -RepositoryUrl $RepositoryUrl
}

if (-not $SkipBaseline) {
    & (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "capture_baseline.ps1")
}

python (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "verify_workspace.py")
python (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "refresh_workspace_manifest.py")
python (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "verify_workspace_manifest.py")

Write-Host "Acquisition complete. Source lock: source/SOURCE_LOCK.json"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
REPOSITORY_URL="${1:-https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code.git}"
EXPECTED_COMMIT="${EXPECTED_COMMIT:-c1ec1915fc16f3dc1ec5d47d9a97f6210a574526}"
BUNDLE_ARG="${2:-}"
STAGING="$ROOT/source/staging/t3code-clone"
BUNDLE_DIR="$ROOT/input/upstream_reference/git-bundles"
BUNDLE_OUT="$BUNDLE_DIR/t3code-$EXPECTED_COMMIT.bundle"

command -v git >/dev/null || { echo "Git is required" >&2; exit 1; }
command -v python3 >/dev/null || { echo "Python 3 is required" >&2; exit 1; }

rm -rf "$STAGING"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$STAGING")" "$BUNDLE_DIR"

BUNDLE="$BUNDLE_ARG"
if [[ -z "$BUNDLE" && -f "$BUNDLE_OUT" ]]; then
  BUNDLE="$BUNDLE_OUT"
fi

if [[ -n "$BUNDLE" ]]; then
  [[ -f "$BUNDLE" ]] || { echo "Bundle not found: $BUNDLE" >&2; exit 1; }
  git bundle verify "$BUNDLE"
  git clone "$BUNDLE" "$STAGING"
  git -C "$STAGING" remote set-url origin "$REPOSITORY_URL"
else
  git clone --no-local "$REPOSITORY_URL" "$STAGING"
fi

git -C "$STAGING" cat-file -e "${EXPECTED_COMMIT}^{commit}"
git -C "$STAGING" checkout --detach "$EXPECTED_COMMIT"
git -C "$STAGING" fsck --full --strict
ACTUAL="$(git -C "$STAGING" rev-parse HEAD)"
[[ "$ACTUAL" == "$EXPECTED_COMMIT" ]] || { echo "Pinned commit mismatch" >&2; exit 1; }
[[ -z "$(git -C "$STAGING" status --porcelain)" ]] || { echo "Source checkout is dirty" >&2; exit 1; }

git -C "$STAGING" bundle create "$BUNDLE_OUT" --all
git bundle verify "$BUNDLE_OUT"

python3 "$ROOT/scripts/ingest_source.py" --directory "$STAGING"

PRIMARY="$ROOT/source/primary"
git -C "$PRIMARY" fsck --full --strict
[[ "$(git -C "$PRIMARY" rev-parse HEAD)" == "$EXPECTED_COMMIT" ]] || { echo "Ingested source commit mismatch" >&2; exit 1; }
[[ -z "$(git -C "$PRIMARY" status --porcelain)" ]] || { echo "Ingested source is dirty" >&2; exit 1; }

echo "Source acquired at $EXPECTED_COMMIT"
echo "Reusable bundle: $BUNDLE_OUT"
